summary: Establish ekodi.kr/developer as the public EKODI Developer and Conformance portal and ekodi.kr/experience as the canonical EKODI Experience portal, while retaining ekodi.kr/experience as a permanent compatibility redirect.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed that the developer public site be built around ekodi.kr/developer under the EKODI Constitution and proposed ekodi.kr/experience for the experience surface, then instructed the build to proceed.
developmentBoundaryAdjustment: The root ekodi.kr/developer becomes the public Developer portal. Development mirrors remain on nested hosts such as ekodi.kr/my/developer, ekodi.kr/admin/developer, ekodi.kr/auth/developer and ekodi.kr/api/developer.
runtimePolicy: At S0, Developer and Experience may share the existing ekodi-experience runtime while retaining separate public contracts and routes. A new independent deployment requires measured evidence.
developerDataRule: Public contracts, examples and browser-local preflight only. No production customer data, reusable secrets, private repository structure or internal provider topology.
experienceDataRule: Synthetic-only by default with Secure Projection and no production writes.
authorityRule: Public preflight never grants production authority. Existing EKODI CI contract, security, tenant/data-boundary, staging, certification and guarded promotion gates remain authoritative.
verificationPolicy: Constitution, platform boundary, public contract drift, Secure Projection, staging host simulation, guarded production release, dev/exp real-host verification and try redirect verification must pass.
rollback: Remove ekodi.kr/developer from the shared public runtime, restore ekodi.kr/experience as the Experience canonical host and reverse the domain registrations through the guarded pipeline. No production customer data migration or rollback is required.
